description:
This 2025 Subaru Outback Limited combines practical versatility with refined comfort, delivering a vehicle built for those who value both capability and quality.

- Auto-Dimming Exterior Mirror w/Approach Light
- Splash Guards
- All-Weather Floor Liners
- Rear Seat Back Protector
- Rear Bumper Cover
- LED Upgrade
- Subaru 11.6 Multimedia System w/Navigation
- Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
- Harman/Kardon® Speakers with 12 Speakers
- SiriusXM with 360L
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- Perforated Leather-Trimmed Upholstery
- Power Moonroof
- All-Wheel Drive
- Electronic Stability Control

The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission delivers dependable performance while achieving 26 city and 32 highway MPG. All-wheel drive comes standard, providing confident traction in varied driving conditions. The independent four-wheel suspension creates a composed ride quality whether navigating city streets or tackling rougher terrain.

Inside, this Limited trim presents notable comfort features. Heated front bucket seats wrapped in perforated leather-trimmed upholstery accommodate long drives with ease. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while automatic dual-zone climate control keeps all passengers comfortable. Memory seat settings personalize your driving position, and the heated steering wheel adds warmth on cold mornings.

Technology integration makes every journey connected and intuitive. The 11.6-inch multimedia system with TomTom navigation and what3words guidance keeps you oriented. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility sync your smartphone seamlessly, while SiriusXM with 360L brings premium satellite radio entertainment. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls maintain focus on the road.

Safety systems provide comprehensive protection. Dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags surround occupants with security. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS work together to maintain vehicle control. An exterior rear parking camera assists with precision backing, and the MySubaru Safety emergency communication system offers peace of mind.

The gray exterior presents a sophisticated appearance enhanced by body-color bumpers, a roof rack for practicality, and an integrated spoiler. LED headlights with automatic high-beam capability improve visibility, while front fog lights handle challenging weather. Alloy wheels and variably intermittent wipers complete the polished presentation.

With only 5,200 miles on the odometer, this Outback Limited offers nearly new condition. We encourage you to visit our showroom to experience firsthand how this vehicle combines Subaru's trusted engineering with the premium comfort of the Limited trim.
